name: 袁隆平
oneLiner: 杂交水稻之父，以三系法大幅提高了水稻单产，惠及数亿人的粮食供给。
oneLinerEn: Father of hybrid rice; his three-line method sharply raised yields, feeding hundreds of millions.
bio: 毕生致力于水稻杂种优势利用，把实验室成果推向千万亩农田，被誉为「让中国人把饭碗端在自己手里」的科学家。
bioEn: He devoted his life to heterosis in rice, turning lab gains into millions of acres of farmland, securing China's food supply.

ideas.v: 利用杂交优势提产
把饭碗端在自己手里

quotes.q: 我毕生的追求，就是让所有人远离饥饿。
quotes.qEn: My lifelong pursuit is to keep hunger away from all.

name: 屠呦呦
school: 药物化学 / 天然产物
oneLiner: 从青蒿中提取青蒿素，开创疟疾治疗新路，获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
oneLinerEn: Extracted artemisinin from sweet wormwood, revolutionizing malaria treatment; Nobel laureate in Physiology or Medicine.
bio: 在古籍启发下改用低温萃取以保留活性成分，使青蒿素成为挽救全球数亿人生命的抗疟药。
bioEn: Inspired by ancient texts, she used low-temperature extraction to preserve the active compound, making artemisinin a life-saver worldwide.

ideas.v: 高效抗疟单体成分
从中医药文献寻线索

quotes.q: 荣誉属于中国科学家群体。
quotes.qEn: The honor belongs to China's community of scientists.

name: 童第周
school: 发育生物学 / 细胞生物学
oneLiner: 中国实验胚胎学奠基人，以鱼类核移植实验探索发育与遗传的奥秘。
oneLinerEn: Founder of experimental embryology in China; his fish nuclear-transfer work probed development and heredity.
bio: 在物资匮乏年代坚持显微操作研究，证明细胞核在发育中的主导作用，并为克隆技术埋下伏笔。
bioEn: With scant resources he pursued micromanipulation, showing the nucleus's leading role in development and prefiguring cloning.

ideas.v: 核主导发育命运
鱼类核移植先驱

quotes.q: 科学的事业，要一代一代传下去。
quotes.qEn: The cause of science must pass from generation to generation.

name: 陈桢
oneLiner: 中国遗传学奠基人之一，以金鱼的遗传与演化研究闻名。
oneLinerEn: A founder of genetics in China, renowned for studies of goldfish inheritance and evolution.
bio: 将孟德尔—摩尔根遗传学说系统引入中国，并以金鱼的变异与选育揭示遗传规律。
bioEn: He introduced Mendelian–Morganian genetics to China and used goldfish variation and breeding to reveal genetic laws.

ideas.v: 以金鱼示遗传变异
ideas.vEn: Goldfish as a model of variation

ideas.v: 在中国建立遗传学研究

quotes.q: 遗传之学，当为中国科学之基。
quotes.qEn: Genetics should be a foundation of Chinese science.

name: 查尔斯·达尔文
oneLiner: 提出以自然选择为核心的生物演化理论，颠覆了神创与静止的自然观。
oneLinerEn: Proposed evolution by natural selection, overturning creationist and static views of nature.
bio: 随小猎犬号环球考察后，于 1859 年出版《物种起源》，用大量证据说明物种随时间变化、共同由来，并把人工选择类比自然选择。
bioEn: After the Beagle voyage he published On the Origin of Species (1859), arguing descent with modification and common ancestry via selection akin to breeding.

ideas.v: 更适应的个体留下更多后代
所有生物源自共同祖先

quotes.q: 能够存活下来的，不是最强壮的，也不是最聪明的，而是最适应变化的。
quotes.qEn: It is not the strongest… but the most adaptable to change that survives.

name: 卡尔·林奈
oneLiner: 创立生物双名法命名体系，为混乱的自然界建立了可检索的秩序。
oneLinerEn: Created binomial nomenclature, bringing retrievable order to a chaotic natural world.
bio: 在《自然系统》中逐级划分界门纲目科属种，用属名＋种加词的双名法统一命名，至今仍是生物分类的骨架。
bioEn: In Systema Naturae he ranked kingdom→species and standardized genus+species binomials—still the backbone of taxonomy.

ideas.v: 属名+种加词唯一标识物种
界门纲目科属种的层级

quotes.q: 上帝创造，林奈整理。
quotes.qEn: God creates, Linnaeus arranges.

name: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔
oneLiner: 通过豌豆杂交实验揭示遗传的单位与规律，奠定现代遗传学基础。
oneLinerEn: Pea-cross experiments revealed the units and laws of inheritance, founding modern genetics.
bio: 他提出性状由离散因子（今称基因）控制，并总结显性、分离与自由组合定律；其工作在当时被忽视，世纪之交才被重新发现。
bioEn: He argued traits are carried by discrete factors (genes) and stated dominance, segregation and independent assortment; overlooked then, rediscovered around 1900.

ideas.v: 等位基因在配子中分开
不同性状独立遗传

quotes.q: 我的时代会到来的。
quotes.qEn: My time will come.

name: 沃森与克里克
oneLiner: 1953 年提出 DNA 双螺旋结构模型，开启分子生物学时代。
oneLinerEn: In 1953 they proposed the DNA double helix, launching the molecular biology era.
bio: 基于弗兰克林等人的 X 射线衍射数据，构建出碱基互补配对、反向平行双链的结构，解释了遗传信息的存储与复制。
bioEn: Building on Franklin's X-ray data, they modeled base-paired antiparallel strands, explaining how genetic info is stored and copied.

ideas.v: 两条反向平行链
A–T、G–C 配对

quotes.q: 我们发现了生命的秘密。
quotes.qEn: We have found the secret of life.

name: 阿尔弗雷德·华莱士
school: 演化生物学 / 生物地理
oneLiner: 独立提出自然选择学说，并与达尔文共同署名，奠定生物地理学。
oneLinerEn: Independently conceived natural selection, co-publishing with Darwin, and founded biogeography.
bio: 在马来群岛考察时提出物种因地理隔离与选择而分化，划定了著名的「华莱士线」，区分亚洲与澳洲动物区系。
bioEn: In the Malay Archipelago he argued geographic isolation plus selection drives divergence, drawing the Wallace Line between Asian and Australian faunas.

ideas.v: 与达尔文同年提出
ideas.vEn: Proposed the same year as Darwin

ideas.v: 生物地理分界

works.title: 论变种偏离原始类型的倾向

quotes.q: 每一个物种都来自此前存在的近缘物种。
quotes.qEn: Every species has come into existence coincident with a pre-existing species.

name: 威廉·汉密尔顿
school: 社会生物学 / 群体遗传
oneLiner: 用亲缘选择解释利他行为，重塑了演化对合作与利他的理解。
oneLinerEn: Explained altruism via kin selection, reshaping how evolution views cooperation.
bio: 他提出 inclusive fitness（内含适合度）：个体可通过帮助近亲繁衍而传递共享基因，从而解释看似牺牲自我的利他行为。
bioEn: He formulated inclusive fitness: helping relatives reproduce spreads shared genes, explaining apparent self-sacrifice.

ideas.v: r·B > C 才利他
直接+间接繁殖成功

works.title: 社会行为的遗传演化
works.titleEn: The Genetical Evolution of Social Behaviour

quotes.q: 利他的真正尺度，是基因的延续。
quotes.qEn: The true measure of altruism is the persistence of genes.

name: 詹姆斯·洛夫洛克
oneLiner: 提出盖亚假说，把生物圈视为自我调节的活系统。
oneLinerEn: Proposed the Gaia hypothesis, viewing the biosphere as a self-regulating living system.
bio: 他认为生命与岩石、大气、海洋共同维持适宜生存的条件（如稳定的氧与温度），强调生物圈整体的反馈与调节能力。
bioEn: He argued life, rocks, air and ocean jointly maintain habitable conditions (stable O₂, temperature), stressing biosphere-wide feedback.

ideas.v: 地球如同一个超级有机体
生物圈维持稳态

works.title: 盖亚：地球生命的新审视
works.titleEn: Gaia: A New Look at Life

quotes.q: 地球是一个单一、自我调节的生命系统。
quotes.qEn: The Earth is a single, self-regulating living system.

name: 爱德华·威尔逊
school: 社会生物学 / 生物多样性
oneLiner: 奠基社会生物学，并终其一生呼吁生物多样性保护。
oneLinerEn: Founded sociobiology and spent his career championing biodiversity conservation.
bio: 他与麦克阿瑟共创岛屿生物地理学，解释物种数随岛屿面积与隔离度变化；后又提出社会生物学，用演化解释社会行为。
bioEn: With MacArthur he co-founded island biogeography (species vs. area & isolation); later he launched sociobiology, explaining social behavior by evolution.

ideas.v: 面积大、隔离近则物种多
ideas.vEn: Bigger, nearer islands hold more species

ideas.v: 保护优先事项

quotes.q: 在自然界面前保持谦卑，是智慧的开端。
quotes.qEn: Humility before the natural world is the beginning of wisdom.

name: 路易斯·巴斯德
oneLiner: 以实验证伪自然发生说，建立细菌致病理论与疫苗，发明巴氏消毒法。
oneLinerEn: Disproved spontaneous generation, founded germ theory and vaccines, and invented pasteurization.
bio: 从晶体光学转向微生物研究，用鹅颈烧瓶实验推翻了生命自生的旧说，研制炭疽、鸡霍乱与狂犬病疫苗，将实验微生物学推向医学实践。
bioEn: Moving from crystal optics to microbes, his swan-flask experiment overturned spontaneous generation; he built vaccines for anthrax, cholera and rabies and turned microbiology into medicine.

ideas.v: 许多疾病由微生物引起。
ideas.vEn: Many diseases are caused by microorganisms.

ideas.v: 以减毒病原激发免疫保护。

quotes.q: 幸运只青睐有准备的头脑。
quotes.qEn: Chance favors only the prepared mind.

name: 珍妮·古道尔
oneLiner: 在冈比溪长期野外观察黑猩猩，发现其使用工具与复杂社会，重写了人与动物的界限。
oneLinerEn: Her decades of Gombe fieldwork on chimpanzee tool use and society redrew the boundary between humans and animals.
bio: 以参与观察法揭示黑猩猩制造工具、捕食与情感生活，促使学界重新定义“人”；此后毕生投身自然保护与公众教育。
bioEn: Through immersive observation she revealed chimps making tools, hunting and feeling, forcing science to redefine 'person'; she then devoted her life to conservation and education.

ideas.v: 黑猩猩修整枝条钓取白蚁。
ideas.vEn: Chimps modify twigs to fish for termites.

ideas.v: 群体间存在习得的行为传统。

quotes.q: 你所做的每件事都有意义，你必须决定要成为什么样的人。
quotes.qEn: What you do makes a difference; you must decide what kind.

name: 林恩·马古利斯
oneLiner: 重提内共生学说，阐明线粒体与叶绿体源于被吞入的细菌，重塑了复杂细胞起源的认识。
oneLinerEn: Revived symbiogenesis, showing mitochondria and chloroplasts arose from engulfed bacteria and recasting the origin of complex cells.
bio: 以大量证据论证真核细胞是早期微生物共生的嵌合体，挑战以竞争为中心的正统演化观，强调合作在演化中的创造力量。
bioEn: With abundant evidence she argued eukaryotes are microbial symbiotic chimera, challenging competition-centric orthodoxy and stressing cooperation's creative role in evolution.

ideas.v: 细胞器源于自由生活的细菌。
合并与共生成就新体形。
ideas.vEn: Merging and symbiosis forge new body plans.

quotes.q: 生命不是靠竞争而成功，而是靠相互依存。
quotes.qEn: Life does not consist of competition but of cooperation and interdependence.

name: 罗伯特·科赫
oneLiner: 用固体培养、显微染色与「科赫法则」把病原学变成严格科学，一一指认炭疽、结核、霍乱的真凶。
oneLinerEn: With solid culture, staining and 'Koch's postulates' he made disease causation a rigorous science, naming anthrax, tuberculosis and cholera's culprits one by one.
bio: 德国医生，现代细菌学的奠基人之一，与巴斯德齐名。他建立起纯培养技术（固体培养基、单菌落分离）、显微染色与摄影，并提出「科赫法则」：一种特定疾病应由一种特定微生物引起，该微生物须能在病患中被分离、纯培养，并在健康宿主中重现同样的病。他据此确认炭疽杆菌（1876）、结核杆菌（1882）与霍乱弧菌的致病地位，发现结核菌素，1905 年获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。法则亦有例外——无症状携带、尚不可培养之病原——后世由病毒学与「分子科赫法则」补足。
bioEn: A German physician, a founder of modern bacteriology, ranked with Pasteur. He built up pure-culture technique (solid media, single-colony isolation), staining and microphotography, and set out Koch's postulates: a specific disease should be caused by a specific microbe, one that can be isolated from the sick, grown pure, and reproducible in a healthy host. On this basis he established the roles of the anthrax bacillus (1876), the tuberculosis bacillus (1882) and the cholera vibrio, discovered tuberculin, and won the 1905 Nobel in physiology or medicine. The postulates have exceptions—asymptomatic carriers, unculturable agents—later met by virology and 'molecular Koch's postulates.'

ideas.v: 以分离、纯培与再现，确立某微生物即某病之因。
ideas.vEn: Isolate, grow pure, reproduce—to prove a microbe is a disease's cause.

ideas.v: 固体培养基上分取单菌落，得干净可检的菌株。
ideas.vEn: Picking single colonies on solid media yields clean, testable strains.

ideas.v: 把「瘴气/体质」的旧解释换成具体可辨的微生物。
ideas.vEn: Replacing miasma and constitution with identifiable microbes.

works.title: 结核病的病因（1882 演讲）

quotes.q: 疾病的真凶是特定的微生物，而非瘴气或体质。
quotes.qEn: The culprits of disease are specific microbes, not miasma or constitution.

name: 卡尔·乌斯
oneLiner: 以 16S 核糖体 RNA 作「分子尺规」重排生命之树，划出全新的第三域——古菌。
oneLinerEn: Using 16S ribosomal RNA as a molecular ruler he rebuilt the tree of life and carved out a wholly new third domain—the archaea.
bio: 美国微生物学家，演化生物学的革新者。他跳出形态与代谢的旧分类，改以高度保守的核糖体小亚基 RNA（原核 16S、真核 18S）序列度量生物间的亲缘，绘制以共同祖先为根的生命之树。1977 年他发现一类「产甲烷菌」在分子层面既非细菌也非真核，遂于 1990 年提出三域系统：细菌域、古菌域与真核生物域。此举重划了生命的高阶版图，并揭示真核细胞本身可能源自古菌与细菌的内共生融合——与马古利斯的学说遥相呼应。
bioEn: An American microbiologist who reinvented evolutionary biology. Rejecting the old classification by form and metabolism, he measured kinship through the highly conserved RNA of the ribosome's small subunit (16S in prokaryotes, 18S in eukaryotes), drawing a tree of life rooted in common ancestors. In 1977 he found that certain 'methanogens' were, at the molecular level, neither bacteria nor eukaryotes, and in 1990 proposed the three-domain system—Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya. It redrew life's high-level map and suggested the eukaryotic cell itself arose from an endosymbiotic fusion of archaea and bacteria—echoing Margulis.

ideas.v: 以核糖体 RNA 序列作衡量亲缘的分子尺规。
ideas.vEn: Ribosomal RNA sequence as the ruler of relatedness.

ideas.v: 生命分为细菌、古菌与真核生物三大域。
ideas.vEn: Life splits into Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya.

ideas.v: 看似细菌却自成一枝，且与真核起源密切相关。
ideas.vEn: Bacteria-like yet a lineage of their own, kin to the origin of eukaryotes.

works.title: 生物的天然系统：三域（1990）
works.titleEn: Towards a Natural System of Organisms: Three Domains

quotes.q: 生命的三大谱系，远不止植物与动物。
quotes.qEn: Life's great divisions run far deeper than plants and animals.

name: 罗莎琳德·富兰克林
oneLiner: 拍下决定性的「照片 51」，以 X 射线衍射揭示 DNA 双螺旋骨架——荣誉却长期旁落。
oneLinerEn: She captured the decisive 'Photo 51', revealing DNA's helical backbone by X-ray diffraction—yet the credit long elided her.
bio: 英国物理化学家与晶体学家。她以精湛的 X 射线衍射拍摄 DNA 纤维照片，其中著名的「照片 51」清楚显示 X 形交叉与规律层线，指向两条链构成的螺旋、碱基朝内、骨架在外，并给出螺旋直径与周期等关键参数；她也独立得出 DNA 磷酸骨架在外、碱基在内的正确图景，精准区分了 A 型与 B 型两种构象。她未充分知情下的数据被同行用于建模；沃森、克里克与威尔金斯于 1962 年获诺贝尔奖时，富兰克林已因卵巢癌于 1958 年病逝，从未分享该奖，遂成科学史上女性贡献被低估的标志性案例。
bioEn: A British physical chemist and crystallographer. With masterful X-ray diffraction she photographed DNA fibres, and the famous 'Photo 51' showed the telltale X-shaped cross and regular layer lines pointing to a two-stranded helix with bases inward and backbone out, giving key parameters of diameter and pitch. She independently reached the correct picture—phosphate backbone without, bases within—and cleanly distinguished the A and B forms. Data of hers, without her full knowledge, fed others' modeling; when Watson, Crick and Wilkins took the 1962 Nobel she had already died of ovarian cancer in 1958 and never shared the prize—an emblem of women's under-credited contributions in science.

ideas.v: 以晶体绕射图样反推分子的三维结构。
ideas.vEn: Reading a molecule's 3-D structure from its diffraction pattern.

ideas.v: B 型 DNA 的清晰绕射图，螺旋的直接证据。
ideas.vEn: The crisp diffraction image of B-form DNA—direct proof of the helix.

ideas.v: 她据数据定出这一正确方向，却未获应有的承认。
ideas.vEn: She reasoned this correct orientation from the data, yet without due credit.

works.title: 钠胸腺核酸的分子构型（1953）

quotes.q: 数据终会自己说话。
quotes.qEn: The data will speak for themselves.

name: 亚里士多德
oneLiner: 系统观察并归类数百种动物，被誉为最早的生物学家，其《动物史》奠定比较解剖与分类的起点。
oneLinerEn: He observed and sorted hundreds of animals, hailed as the first biologist; his History of Animals founded comparative anatomy and classification.
bio: 他在莱斯博斯岛观察海洋生物，按形态与生殖为动物归类，提出「自然阶梯」的观念，其权威统治西方自然知识近两千年。
bioEn: Observing marine life on Lesbos, he grouped animals by form and reproduction and conceived the scala naturae, his authority ruling Western natural knowledge for nearly two millennia.

ideas.v: 知识来自对具体生物的解剖与目见
ideas.vEn: Knowledge comes from dissecting and seeing real creatures

ideas.v: 生物由高到低排成连续等级
ideas.vEn: Life arrayed in a continuous ladder

quotes.q: 自然界不做无用之事。
quotes.qEn: Nature does nothing in vain.

name: 希波克拉底
oneLiner: 把医学从巫术与神谕中分离出来，主张疾病有自然成因，树立观察、预后与医德的临摹传统。
oneLinerEn: He split medicine from sorcery and oracle, held disease to natural causes, and set an observant, prognostic, ethical clinical tradition.
bio: 相传他写下《希波克拉底誓言》，强调环境与饮食对健康的作用，以「自然疗愈力」解释身体的康复过程。
bioEn: Credited with the Hippocratic Oath, he stressed environment and diet, and explained recovery through nature's healing power (vis medicatrix).

ideas.v: 疾病源于身体与自然，而非神罚
ideas.vEn: Disease stems from body and nature, not divine punishment

ideas.v: 身体本有趋向康复的倾向
ideas.vEn: The body tends toward recovery on its own

quotes.q: 首要的一条：不造成伤害。
quotes.qEn: First, do no harm.

name: 威廉·哈维
oneLiner: 以定量实验证明血液由心脏泵出、沿封闭回路循环，一举推翻盖伦关于血流的千年成说。
oneLinerEn: By quantitative experiment he proved the heart pumps blood around a closed circuit, overturning Galen's thousand-year dogma of the flow.
bio: 他结扎血管并测算血流量，推断血必循环而非被不断耗用，1628 年出版《动物心血运动的解剖研究》，奠定实验生理学。
bioEn: Ligating vessels and computing flow, he inferred blood must circulate rather than be consumed, publishing his De Motu in 1628 and founding experimental physiology.

ideas.v: 心脏如泵，推动血液周流不止
ideas.vEn: The heart drives blood round and round like a pump

ideas.v: 动脉与静脉在末梢相连成环
ideas.vEn: Arteries and veins join at their ends in a loop

works.title: 动物心血运动的解剖研究

quotes.q: 我不从书的权威，而从解剖与观察中寻求真理。
quotes.qEn: I seek truth not from the authority of books but from dissection and observation.

name: 拉马克
oneLiner: 先于达尔文提出系统的演化论，以「用进废退」与「获得性遗传」解释物种随环境的渐变。
oneLinerEn: Before Darwin he proposed a full evolutionary theory, explaining gradual change by use and disuse and the inheritance of acquired traits.
bio: 他首创「生物学」一词，把生命看作由简到繁连续攀升的谱系；其机制虽被否定，演化观念却开了先声。
bioEn: He coined the term "biology" and saw life climbing a continuous scale from simple to complex; his mechanism was refuted, yet his evolutionary idea blazed a trail.

ideas.v: 常用器官发达，不用的退化
ideas.vEn: Organs used grow stronger, unused ones waste away

ideas.v: 后天获得的性状可传给后代
ideas.vEn: Traits gained in life can pass to offspring

quotes.q: 自然没有真正的类别，只有我们为之命名的连续。
quotes.qEn: Nature has no real classes, only a continuum we name.

name: 列文虎克
oneLiner: 以自制的简陋单式显微镜，第一次让人看见细菌、精子与红细胞，独自推开微生物世界的大门。
oneLinerEn: With simple microscopes of his own grinding, he was the first to see bacteria, sperm and red blood cells, opening the microbial world almost single-handed.
bio: 荷兰代尔夫特的布商与市政看守，自学磨出高倍小透镜。自 1673 年起他致信英国皇家学会，报告雨水、牙垢与池水中游动的「微小动物」，首次描述了细菌、原生动物与红细胞——却终生不通拉丁文，也不识当时显微学界的行话。
bioEn: A Delft cloth-tradesman and civic guardsman who taught himself to grind high-power lenses; from 1673 he wrote to the Royal Society reporting tiny creatures swimming in rain, tooth-scrape and pond water — the first account of bacteria, protozoa and red blood cells, though he never learned Latin nor the jargon of the science of his day.

ideas.v: 磨小透镜得二三百倍放大
ideas.vEn: Small lenses gave two- to three-hundred-fold

ideas.v: 在牙垢水中看到游动细菌
ideas.vEn: Saw moving bacteria in scraped plaque

ideas.v: 量出精子与红细胞大小
ideas.vEn: Sized sperm and red blood cells

quotes.q: 我不过把水置于透镜下，看它自己会动。
quotes.qEn: I only set water to the lens and watched it move.

name: 蕾切尔·卡森
oneLiner: 以《寂静的春天》揭露农药沿食物链富集，一人之笔催生了现代环境运动。
oneLinerEn: With Silent Spring she exposed how pesticides build up along the food chain; one pen helped found the modern environmental movement.
bio: 美国海洋生物学家与作家，早以海洋三部曲畅销成名；1962 年出版《寂静的春天》，指认某些杀虫剂经食物链放大、毒杀鸟类并危及人体，触怒化工巨头却推动各地禁喷，并促成后来美国环保署的成立。
bioEn: An American marine biologist and writer who first made her name with a trilogy of sea books; in 1962 came Silent Spring, charging that certain pesticides were magnified up the food chain, killing birds and endangering people — defying the chemical industry, spurring spray bans and the later founding of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency.

ideas.v: 农药沿营养级层层放大
ideas.vEn: Poisons multiply up the trophic levels

ideas.v: 化学残留久存水土之间
ideas.vEn: Chemicals linger in soil and water

ideas.v: 把科学写给寻常人家

quotes.q: 人类是自然的一部分，对它的战争就是对自己的战争。
quotes.qEn: We are part of nature, and our war on it is a war on ourselves.

name: 麦克林托克
oneLiner: 在玉米籽粒的花斑里看出基因会「跳跃」，独守其说数十载，终以转座因子获 1983 年诺贝尔奖。
oneLinerEn: Reading mosaic maize kernels she saw that genes could 'jump'; she held to it for decades and won the 1983 Nobel Prize for transposable elements.
bio: 美国细胞遗传学家，长年在冷泉港研究玉米染色体。1940 年代她据籽粒与叶片斑纹提出基因并非固定不动，而是能在染色体间移动、开关邻近性状（她称作「控制因子」）；其说久被冷待，随分子生物学证实转座子而获追认，她成为单独获此诺奖的第一位女性科学家。
bioEn: An American cytogeneticist who long worked on maize chromosomes at Cold Spring Harbor; in the 1940s, from blotchy kernels and leaves, she argued genes were not fixed but could move along the chromosome, switching neighbouring traits (her 'controlling elements') — shunned for decades, then vindicated once transposons were proven, she became the first woman to win the Nobel prize alone.

ideas.v: 控制因子在染色体间移位
据籽粒斑纹推知基因动静
其说超前时代数十年

quotes.q: 我与玉米交谈，它也回应我。
quotes.qEn: I talk to my maize, and it talks back.

name: 杜布赞斯基
oneLiner: 把孟德尔遗传与达尔文选择合流，奠基演化论的「现代综合」；一句「无演化之光则生物学皆无意义」成座右铭。
oneLinerEn: Fusing Mendelian genetics with Darwinian selection, his Genetics and the Origin of Species underpinned the 'modern synthesis'; his dictum — nothing in biology makes sense save in the light of evolution — became a motto.
bio: 生于乌克兰、后赴美的演化生物学家，比对果蝇的染色体与野生种群变异，把群体遗传学的数学与野外观察合流；1937 年《遗传学与物种起源》与同时诸家一同奠定演化论的「现代综合」，将突变、选择与隔离统一为可计算的机制。
bioEn: Born in Ukraine and later an American evolutionary biologist, he studied chromosome variation in wild fruit-fly populations and fused the mathematics of population genetics with field observation; his 1937 Genetics and the Origin of Species, with peers, laid down the modern synthesis, uniting mutation, selection and isolation into a computable mechanism.

ideas.v: 野生果蝇即演化实验室
ideas.vEn: Wild fruit flies as evolution's lab

ideas.v: 遗传学与自然选择合流
无演化则生物学无意义

works.title: 遗传学与物种起源
works.titleEn: Genetics and the Origin of Species

quotes.q: 若无演化之光，生物学的任何一面都无从理解。
quotes.qEn: Nothing in biology makes sense except in the light of evolution.
